description: Ministry of Agriculture - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 1894/04 of 22.12.2014, substituting Propanil, Carbaryl, Chlorpyrifos and Carbofuran active ingredients
reasoning: This gazette content is an order issued under the Control of Pesticides Act, No. 33 of 1980, amending a previous order by repealing and substituting a schedule that lists prohibited pesticides and their restricted areas of use. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving legal amendments to existing legislation, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a government official (the Registrar of Pesticides), it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would qualify for Types 1-3.
